title: Soul Snack #2: The Higher Logic of the Heart
excerpt: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the profound connection between emotional awareness, the heart, and spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the profound connection between emotional awareness, the heart, and spiritual growth. 

He introduces the concept of authentic power and how the journey to spiritual development begins with multisensory perception. 

Gary emphasizes that emotional awareness, particularly through the heart, is central to spiritual transformation. By recognizing the importance of emotions as valuable information, we can better understand our intentions and whether we are creating from a place of love or fear.

Gary encourages us to reflect on how unresolved emotions can stack up like letters in a mailbox, creating blockages in our growth. 

He explains that becoming aware of our emotions allows us to distinguish between the energies of love and fear, which shape the consequences of our actions. 

This awareness is essential for responsible choice-making and aligning ourselves with the universe’s compassion and wisdom.

By living through the heart and making choices rooted in love, we can live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Discuss in This Episode:

  • (02:10) The role of the heart in creating authentic power and emotional awareness.
  • (04:05) How multisensory perception expands your spiritual journey beyond the five senses.
  • (06:15) Understanding two foundational intentions: love and fear.
  • (09:20) Why responsible choice and emotional awareness are key to spiritual growth.
  • (11:45) How the heart connects you to the compassionate, wise energy of the universe.
